# PRSCheck

> SaaS platform for UK local authority housing enforcement teams. Helps councils manage Private Rented Sector (PRS) inspections, complaints, and statutory notices end to end.

PRSCheck digitises the workflow that council housing officers run when enforcing the PRS — from initial complaint intake through HHSRS inspection, statutory notice issuance (Improvement, Prohibition, Hazard Awareness), and prosecution-ready evidence packs. Built for UK councils, aligned to the Housing Act 2004 and the upcoming Renters' Rights Act.

## What we publish
- Council enforcement workflow playbooks
- HHSRS inspection digital checklists
- Statutory notice templates aligned to Housing Act 2004
- Renters' Rights Act impact analysis
- Case studies and ROI benchmarks

## Canonical
https://prscheck.co.uk

## Audience
UK local authority housing, environmental health, and enforcement officers. Not a tenant-facing service — for that see RenterCheck.

## Not in scope
We do not represent tenants in disputes. We are the council-side enforcement platform.
